What shapes an estimate

Why one wig can cost more to rescue.

A useful estimate needs more than a photo. These four factors help explain why a specialist may recommend a different scope after inspection.

01

Condition

Light buildup and severe matting require very different time and handling.

02

Fibre type

Human hair and synthetic fibres respond differently to water, products, and heat.

03

Construction

Lace, closure, full-lace, and machine-made caps have different repair limits.

04

Desired finish

A simple refresh is different from reshaping, customization, or a new style.

Before handover

Prepare your wig in four simple steps.

Good preparation helps a studio identify the wig correctly and understand its current condition.

  1. 01

    Pack it separately

    Use a clean breathable bag or box. Avoid compressing the lace or curls.

  2. 02

    Label the piece

    Add your name and a simple wig description if more than one item is being sent.

  3. 03

    Do not pre-treat

    Avoid adding oils, glue remover, or heat immediately before the assessment.

  4. 04

    Share its history

    Mention colour, bleach, repairs, adhesives, or heat already used on the wig.

FAQs

Before you send your wig.

Can every wig be restored?

No. Fibre condition, construction, previous processing, heat damage, shedding, and lace condition can limit what is safely achievable. A specialist inspection is essential.

How much will treatment cost?

The sample prices on this concept are illustrative only. A real estimate would depend on the wig's fibre, length, construction, condition, and the work agreed after assessment.

How long does restoration take?

Timelines vary with the treatment plan and studio capacity. The example booking dates on this website are mock availability, not a service promise.

Do you work with synthetic wigs?

Some synthetic fibres may be suitable for limited care or restyling, but heat and product compatibility must be checked. Restoration is never guaranteed.

Do you offer pickup and drop-off?

This fictional concept presents illustrative coverage in Lagos and Abuja. A real studio would confirm zones, fees, timing, and safe packaging before collection.
